desc:
Lift, grow and become a MONSTER in Gym Monster, the gym simulator where you train with your friends! Can you become the biggest bodybuilder in the world? 💪

🏋️ Lift weights and train on machines to build muscle and stamina
🤝 Invite your gym buddy and get stronger together
🥚 Hatch eggs and collect powerful pets to multiply your strength
🧑‍🏫 Hire coaches to boost your training
🌴 Unlock new worlds: the Beach, then the lost city of Atlantis
🏆 Beat bosses in bodybuilding competitions and win rewards
🔥 Rebirth to start over stronger, with epic auras
🚀 Climb the global leaderboards and prove you're the strongest!

📢 LATEST UPDATE 📢
🔱 New world: Atlantis! New machines, new pets and a new boss: Trident King!

🖥️ Play on PC, console, mobile and tablet
